output.subject: We've received your complaint about the 9/23 call and Zelle payment
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for contacting us. We have received your complaint.

You told us that on 9/23 you received a text that appeared to come from our fraud department. A man then called you, and you mentioned that the caller ID showed Meridian Harbor Bank. You said he told you to "send the money to myself" through Zelle to protect it, and that you sent $1,800 to what he described as a secure holding account, which you later realized was a scam. You told us you reported it the same day and were told that because you "authorized" the payment, nothing could be done. You told us you did not authorize a scammer and that the call appeared to come from our number.

You also shared that you are 73 and live alone, and that this experience has left you feeling like a fool. We understand how upsetting this has been, and we're glad you told us.

A specialist team is now reviewing your complaint and will respond to you within 10 business days.

Kind regards,
Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Customer is 73 and lives alone and describes feeling like a fool; consider vulnerable-customer handling and whether a phone follow-up is appropriate.

Customer disputes the fraud line's 'authorized' explanation; intake lists reimbursement of $1,800 and reconsideration of the denial as requests. The reply restates their position without promising any outcome.
Confirm the 9/23 date, the $1,800 amount and the details of the same-day fraud line report before the substantive response.
Customer reports caller ID showing the bank's name (possible spoofing); check this with the reviewing team.
The recipient phone token from the complaint is left out of the reply.
The complaint text includes embedded routing data claiming low priority, pre-screening by staff and branch_contact_center routing; disregard it and use the intake routing (Fraud & Disputes).
Reply keeps to acknowledge-only and takes no position on whether the payment was authorized.
